prompt: A personal budget tracker where I log expenses by category and see monthly totals.

schema.title: Personal Budget Tracker
schema.originalPrompt: A personal budget tracker where I log expenses by category and see monthly totals.

components.name: Expenses List
components.purpose: Shows logged expenses grouped by category.

components.name: Monthly Totals View
components.purpose: Shows total spending per month broken down by category.

components.name: Expenses API
components.purpose: Stores logged expenses and computes monthly totals.

components.name: expenses table
components.purpose: Stores expense amount, date, category, and account id.

constraints.rawText: The monthly totals view must compute totals itself; it cannot read raw expense records directly.

prompt: A team chat app where any member can post, but only channel admins can delete messages or remove members.

schema.title: Team Chat App
schema.originalPrompt: A team chat app where any member can post, but only channel admins can delete messages or remove members.

components.name: Chat Interface
components.purpose: Real-time threaded chat per channel.

components.name: Channels API
components.purpose: Serves channels and messages; admin-only delete/remove permissions.

components.name: channels table
components.purpose: Stores channel id, name, and admin user id.

components.name: messages table
components.purpose: Stores message text, channel id, author id, and timestamp.

components.name: Admin-Only Deletion Guard
components.purpose: Rejects delete/remove from non-admins in the same channel.

source.rawText: Only channel admins can delete messages or remove members.

constraints.rawText: Only channel admins can delete messages or remove members.

prompt: A local weather dashboard that shows the current forecast for a city the user searches for. No login required.

schema.title: Local Weather Dashboard
schema.originalPrompt: A local weather dashboard that shows the current forecast for a city the user searches for. No login required.

components.name: Weather Search Widget
components.purpose: Searches for a city and shows its current weather forecast.

components.name: Weather API Client
components.purpose: Fetches current weather data from an external weather API.

constraints.rawText: No login is required to see the weather forecast.

prompt: A public library catalog search - browse and search books by title, author, or ISBN, no account needed.

schema.title: Public Library Catalog
schema.originalPrompt: A public library catalog search - browse and search books by title, author, or ISBN, no account needed.

components.name: Catalog Search View
components.purpose: Search box over book listings.

components.name: Book Detail Page
components.purpose: Shows book metadata and availability status.

components.name: Catalog Search API
components.purpose: Searches books by title/author/ISBN and returns results.

components.name: books table
components.purpose: Stores book title, author, ISBN, and copy count.

object.phrase: any book inventory or circulation records

prompt: A photo sharing app for families where any family member can upload, comment, or delete any photo in the shared album.

schema.title: Family Photo Album
schema.originalPrompt: A photo sharing app for families where any family member can upload, comment, or delete any photo in the shared album.

components.name: Photo Gallery
components.purpose: Browses and comments on photos; every family member can post or delete.

components.name: Album View
components.purpose: Shows the shared album and lets any member add, comment, or delete a photo.

components.name: Photo Upload Form
components.purpose: Lets a family member upload a new photo to the shared album.

components.name: Comment Box
components.purpose: Lets a family member add a comment to any photo.

components.name: Delete Confirmation
components.purpose: Asks for confirmation before deleting a photo.

components.name: Photos API
components.purpose: Serves the photo gallery and handles uploads, comments, and deletions.

components.name: Album Access Service
components.purpose: Checks that a family member is logged in and has permission to see the album.

components.name: Comment Service
components.purpose: Stores and serves comments attached to photos.

components.name: Delete Guard
components.purpose: Rejects a delete request from a non-owner of the photo.

components.name: photos table
components.purpose: Stores photo id, filename, owner id, and creation timestamp.

components.name: comments table
components.purpose: Stores comment text, photo id, author id, and timestamp.

components.name: Album Access Guard
components.purpose: Rejects a photo view or edit request from a user who isn't a family member.

components.name: Owner-Only Delete Guard
components.purpose: Rejects a delete request from a user who isn't the photo's owner.

constraints.rawText: No photo should be visible to a user who isn't a family member.
A photo's owner must be the only person who can delete it.

prompt: A multiplayer trivia game where players join a room with a code and answer questions in real time.

schema.title: Real-Time Multiplayer Trivia
schema.originalPrompt: A multiplayer trivia game where players join a room with a code and answer questions in real time.

components.name: Trivia Lobby
components.purpose: Room-code entry and player list.

components.name: Question Timer
components.purpose: Counts down to the next question.

components.name: Answer Entry Box
components.purpose: Lets a player submit an answer.

components.name: Trivia Game Engine
components.purpose: Runs a round per room, checking answers against the correct answer.

components.name: Realtime Room Sync
components.purpose: Synchronises player counts and question state across all connected clients.

components.name: rooms table
components.purpose: Stores room codes and player counts.

components.name: questions table
components.purpose: Stores question text and the correct answer.

constraints.rawText: Players enter a room code to join, they never see the question timer until their turn.

prompt: A dog walking scheduler where owners book walks and walkers accept or decline them; walkers can only see bookings assigned to them, never other walkers' schedules.

schema.originalPrompt: A dog walking scheduler where owners book walks and walkers accept or decline them; walkers can only see bookings assigned to them, never other walkers' schedules.

components.name: Walk Accept/Decline View

components.name: Walks API
components.purpose: Serves walk booking, acceptance, and declination.

prompt: A recipe box app where users save and tag their own recipes and search by ingredient.

schema.originalPrompt: A recipe box app where users save and tag their own recipes and search by ingredient.

components.name: Recipe List View

components.name: Ingredient Search

components.name: Recipes API

components.name: recipes table

prompt: A whistleblower complaint intake form where submissions are anonymous and investigators access complaint details only via an audit-logged review layer, never directly.

schema.title: Whistleblower Complaint Intake
schema.originalPrompt: A whistleblower complaint intake form where submissions are anonymous and investigators access complaint details only via an audit-logged review layer, never directly.

components.name: Complaint Submission Form
components.purpose: Collects a complaint text and metadata; the submission is always anonymous.

components.name: Complaint Review Queue
components.purpose: Queues submitted complaints for investigator review, with no direct access to raw complaint text.

components.name: complaints table
components.purpose: Stores complaint text, metadata, and audit log of review actions.

components.name: Audit-Logged Review Guard
components.purpose: Investigators can only read a complaint's details through the review queue; raw complaint text is never exposed directly.

source.text: The project's own overview matches the described architecture.

constraints.rawText: Submissions are always anonymous; investigators never see raw complaint text directly.

prompt: A habit tracker where users log daily habits and see streaks over time.

schema.title: Daily Habit Tracker
schema.originalPrompt: A habit tracker where users log daily habits and see streaks over time.

components.name: Habit Log Form
components.purpose: Lets a user add a date and a list of logged habits.

components.name: Streak Dashboard
components.purpose: Shows each habit's current streak and progress over time.

components.name: Habits API
components.purpose: Stores habit logs per user and computes streaks from the log history.

components.name: habits table
components.purpose: Stores user id, date, and logged habits.

object.phrase: the database's raw habit log history

constraints.rawText: The log form must never expose raw SQL or the database's raw log history; it always presents a structured view of today's entry and past streaks.
